SELECT t.period, SUM(t.dealAmount) AS dealAmount, SUM(t.contractAmount) AS contractAmount, SUM(t.receivedAmount) AS receivedAmount, SUM(t.newCustomerCount) AS newCustomerCount, SUM(t.dealCount) AS dealCount FROM ( SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.close_date, '%Y')
CONCAT(YEAR(o.close_date), '-Q', QUARTER(o.close_date))
DATE_FORMAT(o.close_date, '%Y-%m')
AS period, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN o.actual_amount ELSE 0 END) AS dealAmount, 0 AS contractAmount, 0 AS receivedAmount, 0 AS newCustomerCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS dealCount FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.close_date IS NOT NULL
AND o.close_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY period
UNION ALL
SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(pr.payment_date, '%Y')
CONCAT(YEAR(pr.payment_date), '-Q', QUARTER(pr.payment_date))
DATE_FORMAT(pr.payment_date, '%Y-%m')
AS period, 0 AS dealAmount, 0 AS contractAmount, SUM(pr.payment_amount) AS receivedAmount, 0 AS newCustomerCount, 0 AS dealCount FROM crm_payment_record pr LEFT JOIN crm_contract c ON c.id = pr.contract_id WHERE pr.status = 1 AND pr.payment_date IS NOT NULL
AND pr.payment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND c.owner_id = #{userId} AND c.dept_id = #{deptId} AND c.dept_id IN (${scopeDeptIds}) GROUP BY period
UNION ALL
SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(cu.create_time, '%Y')
CONCAT(YEAR(cu.create_time), '-Q', QUARTER(cu.create_time))
DATE_FORMAT(cu.create_time, '%Y-%m')
AS period, 0 AS dealAmount, 0 AS contractAmount, 0 AS receivedAmount, COUNT(cu.id) AS newCustomerCount, 0 AS dealCount FROM crm_customer cu WHERE cu.pool_type = 1 AND cu.create_time IS NOT NULL
AND DATE(cu.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY period ) t WHERE t.period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.period ORDER BY t.period ASC

SELECT cu.id AS customerId, cu.customer_name AS customerName, cu.customer_type AS customerType, u.user_name AS ownerName, COALESCE(c.totalContractAmount, 0) AS totalContractAmount, COALESCE(c.totalReceivedAmount, 0) AS totalReceivedAmount, COALESCE(c.contractCount, 0) AS contractCount, COALESCE(o.opportunityCount, 0) AS opportunityCount, c.firstDealTime, c.lastDealTime FROM crm_customer cu LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = cu.owner_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, SUM(contract_amount) AS totalContractAmount, SUM(received_amount) AS totalReceivedAmount, COUNT(*) AS contractCount, MIN(create_time) AS firstDealTime, MAX(create_time) AS lastDealTime FROM crm_contract WHERE status = 3
GROUP BY customer_id ) c ON c.customer_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS opportunityCount FROM crm_opportunity WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY customer_id ) o ON o.customer_id = cu.id WHERE cu.pool_type = 1
ORDER BY totalContractAmount DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT cu.id FROM crm_customer cu LEFT JOIN crm_customer_follow f ON f.customer_id = cu.id WHERE cu.pool_type = 1
GROUP BY cu.id, cu.create_time HAVING DATEDIFF(NOW(), COALESCE(MAX(f.create_time), cu.create_time)) >= 30 ) t

SELECT s.id AS stageId, s.stage_name AS stageName, s.sort AS stageOrder, COUNT(o.id) AS opportunityCount, SUM(o.expected_amount) AS opportunityAmount, ROUND(SUM(o.expected_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(( SELECT SUM(o_all.expected_amount) FROM crm_opportunity o_all WHERE o_all.status IN (1, 2, 3)
AND o_all.owner_id = #{userId} AND o_all.dept_id = #{deptId} AND o_all.dept_id IN (${scopeDeptIds})
AND ( DATE(o_all.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} OR (o_all.status IN (2, 3) AND o_all.close_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) )
), 0), 2) AS percentage, s.probability AS probability FROM crm_opportunity_stage s LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity o ON o.stage_id = s.id AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.owner_id = #{userId} AND o.dept_id = #{deptId} AND o.dept_id IN (${scopeDeptIds})
WHERE s.status = 1
GROUP BY s.id, s.stage_name, s.sort, s.probability ORDER BY s.sort ASC

SELECT CASE c.status WHEN 1 THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN 2 THEN 'APPROVING' WHEN 3 THEN 'EFFECTIVE' WHEN 4 THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN 5 THEN 'TERMINATED' END AS status, CASE c.status WHEN 1 THEN '草稿' WHEN 2 THEN '审批中' WHEN 3 THEN '生效' WHEN 4 THEN '到期' WHEN 5 THEN '终止' END AS statusName, COUNT(c.id) AS contractCount, SUM(c.contract_amount) AS contractAmount, ROUND(SUM(c.contract_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(( SELECT SUM(c_all.contract_amount) FROM crm_contract c_all WHERE 1 = 1
AND c_all.owner_id = #{userId} AND c_all.dept_id = #{deptId} AND c_all.dept_id IN (${scopeDeptIds})
AND ( DATE(c_all.create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} OR (c_all.sign_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(c_all.sign_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) OR (c_all.end_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(c_all.end_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) )
), 0), 2) AS percentage, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status = 3 AND DATEDIFF(c.end_date, NOW()) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiringCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status IN (3, 4) AND c.end_date < NOW() AND c.received_amount < c.contract_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiredNotTerminatedCount FROM crm_contract c WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY c.status ASC

SELECT c.id AS contractId, c.contract_no AS contractNo, cu.customer_name AS customerName, c.contract_amount AS contractAmount, c.received_amount AS receivedAmount, ROUND(c.received_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.contract_amount, 0), 2) AS progressRate, c.contract_amount - c.received_amount AS pendingAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.received_status = 0 AND pp.plan_date < NOW() THEN pp.plan_amount ELSE 0 END) AS overdueAmount, MIN(CASE WHEN pp.received_status = 0 THEN DATE_FORMAT(pp.plan_date, '%Y-%m-%d') END) AS nextPaymentDate, CASE WHEN c.received_amount >= c.contract_amount THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN pp.received_status = 0 AND pp.plan_date < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS paymentStatus FROM crm_contract c LEFT JOIN crm_customer cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_payment_plan pp ON pp.contract_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 3
GROUP BY c.id, c.contract_no, cu.customer_name, c.contract_amount, c.received_amount ORDER BY progressRate ASC

SELECT c.id AS contractId, c.contract_no AS contractNo, cu.customer_name AS customerName, c.contract_amount AS contractAmount, c.end_date AS endDate, DATEDIFF(c.end_date, NOW()) AS daysToExpire, u.user_name AS ownerName FROM crm_contract c LEFT JOIN crm_customer cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.status = 3 AND DATEDIFF(c.end_date, NOW()) BETWEEN 0 AND #{days}
AND c.owner_id = #{userId} AND c.dept_id = #{deptId} AND c.dept_id IN (${scopeDeptIds}) ORDER BY c.end_date ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS contractId, c.contract_no AS contractNo, cu.customer_name AS customerName, pp.plan_amount AS overdueAmount, pp.plan_date AS planDate, DATEDIFF(NOW(), pp.plan_date) AS overdueDays, u.user_name AS ownerName FROM crm_payment_plan pp LEFT JOIN crm_contract c ON c.id = pp.contract_id LEFT JOIN crm_customer cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.status = 3 AND pp.received_status = 0 AND pp.plan_date < NOW()
AND c.owner_id = #{userId} AND c.dept_id = #{deptId} AND c.dept_id IN (${scopeDeptIds}) ORDER BY pp.plan_date ASC LIMIT #{limit}
